_doc: Declaration of what each delivered modification changed, per source. shape_changed: true when the silhouette/position of any element changes (text wider, octagon moved, letters with a different contour) -> auxiliary maps listed in requires_on_shape_change must be delivered too. null = not declared (WARN).

t_roadsigns.note: Phase 5: glyph tiles (street names, EXIT/NEXT, directions, TOLL, CAUTION/TOLL PLAZA/AHEAD, ROAD/WORK, ROAD CLOSED stencil, CAUTION UNDER CONSTRUCTION) are cut by the opacity map -> t_roadsigns_o.data rebuilt and delivered. Panel texts change only the base colour.

t_decal_roadmarkings.note: Phase 6 (6A): words of slots 3,5,6,7,8,9,14 rewritten in colour, opacity, normal and AO (both atlas copies); roughness/metallic not tied to the letters -> original.

eca_genericsigns.note: Phase 6 (6B): texts of the panels used in the West Coast changed inside the same panels; opacity/normal/AO/roughness hold only panel outlines -> unchanged.

t_billboards.note: Phase 6 (6C): slogans/prices on the billboard atlas; roughness map is a generic panel texture.

t_movie_studio_signage.note: Phase 6 (6D): texts inside the same sign panels; the material has only a base colour map.

ind_industrial_signs.note: Phase 6 (6D): texts inside the same sign panels; single base colour map.

t_spearleaf_refinery_logo.note: Phase 6 (6D): REFINERY -> REFINARIA; letters cut by the opacity map -> colour + opacity delivered.

t_steel_factory_brand.note: Phase 6 (6D): STEEL MANUFACTURING -> FABRICAÇÃO DE AÇO; letter relief re-applied in normal, AO and roughness.

t_bus_routes_wca.note: Phase 6 (6E): title, legend and stop names; the normal map embosses every label -> relief rebuilt for the new text (AO/roughness carry no text).

clutter_commercial.note: Phase 6 (6F): commercial and dealership clutter atlas (art_shapes copy loaded by material clutter_commercial). Neon signs and SALE% posters are opacity cut-outs -> opacity rebuilt for the new letters.

t_decal_roadmarkings.note: Legacy: letters replaced (PARE, ÔNIBUS, MANTENHA…) -> letter contours changed.

eca_genericsigns.note: Legacy: layout changed (Pousada Firwood, Nodeoline redrawn).

t_spearleaf_refinery_logo.note: Legacy: text changed; opacity mask delivered.
